designation: IN THE COURT OF CHIEF JUDICIAL MAGISTRATE
jurisdictionNote: Chief Judicial Magistrate — jurisdiction under S.16 BNSS. Tries offences punishable with imprisonment up to 7 years. Has powers of remand (S.187 BNSS), first bail hearing for non-bailable offences within CJM jurisdiction, and supervisory authority over JMFCs in the district.

prayer_language.opening: It is, therefore, most humbly prayed that this Hon'ble Court may be pleased to:
prayer_language.closing: And for this act of kindness, the applicant/accused shall ever pray.

verification_format:
I, {deponent_name}, {designation}, do hereby verify that the contents of the above application are true and correct to my knowledge and belief.

Verified at {place} on this {date}.

DEPONENT
localRules: CJM has jurisdiction over offences punishable up to 7 years (S.16 BNSS).
Bail applications for non-bailable offences within CJM jurisdiction to mention FIR details and custody period.
All applications to be filed with index and pagination.
Vakalatnama to be filed at the first instance.
Certified copy of FIR and remand order to be attached with bail applications.
Default bail under S.187(2) BNSS if charge sheet not filed within 60/90 days.
